veranderings.blok: Liggaamfossiele is dele van die lyf
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: en joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Liggaamfossiele is dele van die lyf
veranderings.voor: kan hulle vorm in die klip agterbly
veranderings.na: kan hul vorm in die klip agterbly
veranderings.rede: 'hulle vorm' can be misread as 'they form'; the possessive 'hul' removes the ambiguity.
'laat' alone does not mean 'leave behind'; the verb is 'agterlaat', as the lesson uses elsewhere.
'agterlos' is colloquial; 'agterlaat' is the standard verb and matches the definition's 'agtergelaat'.

veranderings.voor: hulle spore in die modder gelos
veranderings.na: hulle spore in die modder agtergelaat
veranderings.rede: 'gelos' means 'let be' rather than 'left behind'; 'agtergelaat' is correct and ties to the term's definition.

veranderings.voor: gelê en hulle is dus spoorfossiele
veranderings.na: gelê, en hulle is dus spoorfossiele
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: en joins two sentences with their own subjects; the protected wording stays intact.

veranderings.voor: gedoen het en daarom is dit
veranderings.na: gedoen het, en daarom is dit
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: en joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Fossiele wat lyk soos plante en diere van vandag
veranderings.voor: is ook nie sommer dieselfde soort nie
veranderings.na: is ook nie noodwendig dieselfde soort nie
veranderings.rede: 'sommer' is colloquial and vague here; 'noodwendig' states the intended 'not necessarily' clearly.

vlae.teks: 'n Fossiel van 'n teken wat 'n plant of dier agtergelaat het, is 'n spoorfossiel.
vlae.rede: This study sentence lacks the closing phrase 'nie van 'n deel van sy lyf nie' that the protected entry says keeps a leaf imprint among body fossils; adding it is content, so not changed here. Not a safety flag.
